description: Common IPC metrics emitted by Netflix's service mesh (proxyd) and paved-path IPC clients/servers. Unlike AWS CloudWatch metrics, these are instrumented and controlled by Netflix engineering directly.

ipc.protocol.description: Wire protocol used for the call.

ipc.status.description: Detailed status of the call, consistently mapped from HTTP/gRPC status codes across the dashboarding stack.

ipc.attempt.description: Retry attempt number for the call, derived from the Netflix-Egress-Attempt header.

ipc.vip.description: Virtual IP (VIP) or service name of the target. For ipc.client.call, derived from the target address pattern (VIP, Secure, gRPC, or EurekaDNS); defaults to the authority header if unmatched. For ipc.server.call, set from the Netflix-Vip header, or 'unknown'.

ipc.endpoint.description: Logical endpoint name for the call, set from the Netflix-Egress-Endpoint-Name / Netflix-Ingress-Endpoint-Name header.

ipc.client.app.description: Application identifier of the calling service, derived from the Netflix-Egress-Client-Id header.

ipc.server.app.description: Application identifier of the upstream/server instance handling the call.

ipc.client.asg.description: Auto-scaling group of the calling instance, derived from the request Netflix-ASG header.

ipc.client.cluster.description: Cluster of the calling instance, derived from the request Netflix-ASG header.

ipc.server.asg.description: Auto-scaling group of the server instance, derived from the response Netflix-ASG header.

ipc.server.cluster.description: Cluster of the server instance, derived from the response Netflix-ASG header.

owner.description: Component that emitted the metric. Filter by owner=proxyd to isolate metrics emitted by the mesh proxy and avoid double-counting against metrics emitted directly by a workload.

build.revision.description: Version of the main packages (proxyd, Envoy) that emitted the metric.

ipc.client.call.description: Timer recording the latency of outgoing IPC calls made by a client.

ipc.protocol.description: Wire protocol used for the call.

ipc.attempt.description: Retry attempt number for the call.

owner.description: Component that emitted the metric, e.g. proxyd.

ipc.client.call.size.inbound.description: Distribution summary of the response payload size received by the client for an IPC call.

ipc.protocol.description: Wire protocol used for the call.

ipc.client.call.size.outbound.description: Distribution summary of the request payload size sent by the client for an IPC call.

ipc.protocol.description: Wire protocol used for the call.

ipc.server.call.description: Timer recording the latency of incoming IPC calls handled by a server.

ipc.protocol.description: Wire protocol used for the call.

ipc.vip.description: VIP the request was addressed to, or 'unknown'.

ipc.endpoint.description: Logical endpoint name that served the call.

owner.description: Component that emitted the metric, e.g. proxyd.

ipc.server.call.size.inbound.description: Distribution summary of the request payload size received by the server for an IPC call.

ipc.protocol.description: Wire protocol used for the call.

ipc.endpoint.description: Logical endpoint name that served the call.

ipc.server.call.size.outbound.description: Distribution summary of the response payload size sent by the server for an IPC call.

ipc.protocol.description: Wire protocol used for the call.

ipc.endpoint.description: Logical endpoint name that served the call.

ipc.server.inflight.description: Gauge tracking the number of IPC requests currently being processed concurrently by a server.

ipc.endpoint.description: Logical endpoint name that served the call.

owner.description: Component that emitted the metric, e.g. proxyd.
